messages:
maya (PM): Quick alignment thread for tenant prewarm + fallback pilot. Need clear launch criteria, infra lead times, and security signoff. Short replies plz. :wave:

kevin (eng-runtime): SLO targets? model pinning per-tenant? runtime needs model pinning to avoid noisy neighbors.

maya (PM): Targets: interactive p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 600ms. Pinning required for pilot.

sara (infra): We can do soft isolation (namespaces + ACLs) for pilot. Hard carve-outs take ~4w. Capacity req + peering doc needed to start; ~2w to get into staging.

tom (security): KMS OK for pilot. I need a short proof plan showing no KV leakage and required audit log fields. 3 business days review after infra doc.

aditi (eng-sre): Operational constraints: add circuit-breaker for prewarm spikes (max 3 attempts per tenant) + alerting channel. Need runbook for retries/backoff.

liam (eng-platform): Platform will add route.policy keys: prewarm_seconds, prewarm_attempts, isolation_mode, fallback_model. UI shows per-tenant prewarm status. PR planned Wed.

jen (solutions): I'll assemble acceptance prompt-set + traffic script customers can run in staging.

maya (PM): Decisions: 1) soft isolation for pilot, 2) model pinning, 3) KMS only, 4) prewarm circuit-breaker (3 attempts), 5) platform knobs as listed.

maya (PM): Action owners & ETA:
- infra (sara): capacity ticket + ACL/peering doc by Thu COB
- runtime (kevin): prewarm reservation + fallback gating PR by Tue
- platform (liam): route.policy UI/API PR by Wed
- security (tom): proof plan + audit fields after infra doc (3 business days)
- sre (aditi): alert/runbook draft by Tue
- solutions (jen): acceptance pack by Tue

sara (infra): will open the ticket and link it here when ready.

kevin (eng-runtime): Note: fallback will route to a quantized model variant; we'll add a lightweight canary eval and an auto-rollback hook on quality regressions.

maya (PM): Great. If no objections, I'll publish launch criteria doc tomorrow and kick infra off. Thanks all. :rocket:
